title: Discounts and coupons
intro: Configure promotional pricing: discount rules with reasons and role permissions, plus coupon codes staff can apply at payment.

sections.title: Discount rules
sections.intro: Discount rules define automatic or manual reductions by category, scope, and eligibility.
steps: Open the Discounts tab in Manage.
Select the Rules sub-tab.
Add or edit rules; set type, value, scope, and when the discount applies.
sections.caption: Discount rules list.

sections.title: Discount reasons
sections.intro: Reasons appear when staff apply manual discounts so reporting can track why a reduction was given.
steps: Open Discounts and switch to the Reasons sub-tab.
Create reasons staff can pick at the payment or cart screen.
Deactivate reasons you no longer want offered.
sections.caption: Discount reasons maintenance.

sections.title: Discount permissions
sections.intro: Control which roles may apply each discount type or exceed limits without manager approval.
steps: Open Discounts and switch to the Permissions sub-tab.
Review the matrix of roles versus discount capabilities.
Adjust permissions so only authorized roles can grant large or sensitive discounts.
sections.caption: Discount permission matrix.

sections.title: Coupons
steps: Open the Coupons tab.
Create coupon codes with value, validity window, and usage limits.
Staff enter coupons on the payment screen when the order qualifies.
sections.caption: Coupons tab.

sections.title: Discount rule form
sections.intro: Categories classify rules for permissions and reporting: manager, staff, vip, corporate, happy_hour, category, product, floor, damage_wastage, service_recovery, bulk_order, manual, scheduled, buy_x_get_y. Scope sets whether discounts apply to items, categories, cart, customers, or floors. Buy X Get Y uses the conditions editor instead of simple targets.
steps: Open Admin → Promotions → Discounts → Rules.
Set name, category, scope, and application mode (manual, automatic, or both).
Configure targets for the chosen scope.
Set percent or fixed value range, priority, schedules, and stacking.
Save — cache refreshes and the rule is available in POS/discount engine.
sections.caption: Discount rule form with category and targets.

fields.name: Category
fields.effect: One of 14 types — manager, staff, vip, corporate, happy_hour, category, product, floor, damage_wastage, service_recovery, bulk_order, manual, scheduled, buy_x_get_y — used for permissions and analytics.

fields.name: Scope
fields.effect: item, category, cart, customer, or floor — determines target editor.

fields.name: Application mode
fields.effect: manual (cashier applies), automatic (engine applies), or both.

fields.name: Targets
fields.effect: Specific items, categories, customers, or floors eligible for the rule.

fields.name: Type (percent / fixed)
fields.effect: Whether min/max rates are percentages or currency amounts.

fields.name: Min / max rate
fields.effect: Allowed discount range for manual entry or auto calculation.

fields.name: Max cap
fields.effect: Percent discounts only — upper currency limit per application.

fields.name: Priority
fields.effect: Order when multiple automatic rules compete.

fields.name: Min order amount
fields.effect: Cart subtotal required before the rule can apply.

fields.name: Stacking mode
fields.effect: allow, prevent, highest_wins, or priority vs. other discounts.

fields.name: Tax treatment
fields.effect: tax_before_discount, tax_after_discount, inclusive, or exclusive.

fields.name: Schedules
fields.effect: Day/time windows for scheduled and happy_hour categories.

fields.name: Conditions
fields.effect: Buy X Get Y thresholds and free-item logic.

fields.name: Requires reason / approval
fields.effect: Forces reason pick or manager PIN when applied manually.

sections.title: Coupon form
steps: Open Promotions → Coupons.
Set code, discount type/value, and usage limits.
Configure valid days, time window, and date range.
Save — cashiers enter the code at payment.
sections.caption: Coupon form.

fields.name: Code
fields.effect: String customers or staff enter at checkout.

fields.name: Coupon type
fields.effect: Single-use, multi-use, or other coupon behavior.

fields.name: Discount type / value
fields.effect: Percent or fixed amount taken off the order.

fields.name: Min order amount
fields.effect: Minimum subtotal before the coupon applies.

fields.name: Max discount amount
fields.effect: Cap on percent-based coupon savings.

fields.name: Usage limit
fields.effect: Total redemptions allowed across all customers.

fields.name: Usage limit per user
fields.effect: Redemptions allowed per customer profile.

fields.name: Valid days / start & end time
fields.effect: Restricts coupon to certain weekdays and hours.

fields.name: Start / end date
fields.effect: Overall validity window.

fields.name: Stackable / first order only
fields.effect: Combining rules with other discounts or new customers only.
